$comment: Per-file budgets for unbundled public assets. Baseline 2026-09-30 (raw/gzip bytes): events-calendar 8108/2793, going-count 2776/1145, member-profile 5193/1977, past-events 3778/1434, styles 2087/882. Ceilings leave roughly 25-45% headroom, not room for a framework import. Islands added later start at measured size plus 25-33% headroom: copy-link (ceilings 3072/1280), avatar 610 raw (1024/512), admin-event-editor 979/482 (1280/640), admin-event-text-limits 1594/725 (2048/1024), auth-status 4152/1576 (5120/2048) and rsvp-button 28628/7371 (35840/9728, added on main by #98). Every JavaScript file under public/islands at any depth must have a budget. Raising a ceiling requires a separate deliberate PR explaining the growth; never relax a budget just to make CI green. Measured at main fb63afa (2026-10-02), five pre-existing assets exceed their unchanged ceilings: events-calendar.js 12060/3919, going-count.js 5321/2062, member-profile.js 14612/4581, past-events.js 5871/1972 (raw only) and public/styles.css 5678/1841. They keep their ceilings here and the checker reports them over budget until an explicit ceiling decision or a size reduction lands. Assets are main's files unchanged; this PR adds gates only and does not rewrite or minify served CSS or JavaScript.
